layout/exploded-view.notes:
While apart the content does not take presses: a press picks the plate under it (`onPick`). The marks are
`data-m-xv` attributes, present only while apart and on the way back; when the content is drawn again or resized
while apart, the plates are found and measured again.
layout/exploded-view.a11y:
Together, the view adds nothing: the content is as accessible as it was. Apart, it is a `group` with a name; the
ghost plates and the tags are hidden from assistive technology (they repeat what the content says). Keyboard focus
stays in the content. The movement is CSS transitions of `transform` / `translate`: reduced motion makes it instant.

layout/layout.a11y:
A skip link to `main` (focusable, `tabindex="-1"`); landmarks `header`, `nav` (aside element), `main`, `aside`,
`footer`; corners are `role="group"` with a translated name. `routeFocus` moves focus to main after a route change and
reads the new title in a polite live region. The reading bar is a `progressbar` that keeps working with reduced motion.

layout/overlay-scope.notes: Layers take `target`: `"nearest"` (default), `"page"`, or a scope element (`openDialog`, `openDrawer`, `<Portal>`).
layout/overlay-scope.a11y:
Focus moves into a dialog opened in the scope and back out on close as usual; while it is open, only the scope's inside
is inert, so the page outside (the showcase around a preview) stays reachable.

layout/panel-header.a11y:
The root is a `<header>` (or `<footer>`); the title is a real heading (`titleAs`) whose `titleId` names the panel
through `aria-labelledby`. The close button is an IconButton with an accessible name (`closeLabel`); a press on it
never reaches the bar's own pointer handlers, so closing does not start a drag. A focusable bar (`tabindex`) shows the
focus ring. Text is cut with an ellipsis instead of pushing the actions out; logical properties mirror it in RTL.

layout/resize-handle.a11y:
With `value` + `set`: `role="separator"` with its orientation, `aria-valuenow` / `min` / `max` kept current, an
accessible name (`label`), focusable (a grid that manages focus passes `tabindex="-1"`). Arrows step (mirrored in
RTL), Shift and Page keys take big steps, Home / End go to the limits, Enter resets, Escape during a drag restores.
A bare grip is `aria-hidden` and not focusable: its owner offers the keyboard way (or pass `onStep` to make the grip
itself focusable with arrow keys). The focus ring is the line itself; on touch screens the hit strip is wider.

layout/window.a11y:
The window is a `section` named by its title. The title bar is focusable: arrows move the window (Alt: 1 px), Shift and
arrows resize it, Enter fills or restores, Escape restores a filled, docked or folded window. Every button has a name
that follows the state ("Fill the area" / "Restore"). Reduced motion turns the size and place transitions off.
